briefings.title: Building a Company in Stealth | Travis Kalanick with a16z
briefings.tldr: Travis Kalanick, Ben Horowitz, and Erik Torenberg reflect on Uber's legendary early days, the 2011 Series B investment that nearly happened with a16z, and Kalanick's 8-year stealth return building Atoms—a company digitizing the physical world across food, mining, and autonomous transport using industrial AI.

briefings.title: Two Legendary Founders: Travis Kalanick & Michael Dell Live from Austin, Texas
briefings.tldr: Travis Kalanick officially exits stealth mode with "Atoms," a company focused on automating the physical world across food, mining, and robotics, while Michael Dell details Dell Technologies' $50B pivot toward AI infrastructure and a landmark $6.25B gift to seed investment accounts for 25 million American children.
